_comment: Mirrors the chain-mapping approach at agenticplace.pythai.net/allchain.html. eid = LayerZero V2 Endpoint ID (NOT the EVM chainId). Fill in `oft` addresses as each DeployHub/DeploySpoke script completes, then re-run WireOApp.s.sol on every already-deployed chain to add the new peer.

_non_lz_chains._comment: Algorand is not a LayerZero-supported chain. Bridged via the separate x402 gateway (src/gateway/X402AlgorandGateway.sol), not via OFT peering. See docs/X402_BRIDGE.md.

_verify_before_mainnet_use: LayerZero endpoint addresses and eids above are the standard V2 values published at docs.layerzero.network/v2/deployments/deployed-contracts as of this writing — re-verify against the live deployments page before broadcasting to mainnet, since LayerZero periodically adds/updates endpoints.
